You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: From which date does Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 apply?

Facts:

[1] Article 6(2) to (6), (8) and (11) and Articles 47 and 53(3) — appliesFrom — 20 July 2024 (2024-07-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 14]
[2] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7]
[3] Directive 2006/42/EC — repealedFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
[4] Article 6(7) and Articles 48 and 52 — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 13]
[5] This Directive — appliesFrom — 20th day following its publication (20th day following its publication) [DIR, Art. 28]
[6] Article 50(1) — appliesFrom — 20 October 2026 (2026-10-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 12]
[7] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC — placingAllowedUntil — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6] [note: the date 2027-01-14 quoted in this condition was corrected to 2027-01-20 by CORR, Corrigendum, point 10]
[8] provisions necessary to comply with this Directive — appliesFrom — 29 December 2009 (2009-12-29) [DIR, Art. 26(1)]
[9] power to adopt delegated acts — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: for a period of five years] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 3]
[10] Articles 26 to 42 — appliesFrom — 20 January 2024 (2024-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 11]
[11] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[12] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[13] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[14] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]
[15] original EC declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[16] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[17] EU declaration of incorporation — hasObligation — shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned (shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references) [condition: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity] [REG, Art. 22(3)]
[18] machinery CE marking date — hasObligation — It is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery (it is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery) [condition: when affixing the CE marking] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]
[19] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[20] EU declaration of incorporation — hasObligation — shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts (shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts) [condition: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity] [REG, Art. 22(3)]
[21] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[22] economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1 — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [REG, Art. 19(2)]
[23] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[24] copy of EU declaration of incorporation, kept by importers — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[25] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — the place and date of the declaration (the place and date of the declaration) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[26] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[27] impianti di protezione contro le scariche atmosferiche eseguiti prima del 27 marzo 2008 e dopo il 31 marzo 1990 — hasDeclaration — dichiarazione di rispondenza (dichiarazione di rispondenza) [condition: Nel caso in cui la dichiarazione di conformità non sia più reperibile] [inail-guide, p. 19]
[28] revisione periodica dei recipienti — hasTimeLimit — 31 dicembre del decimo anno successivo al collaudo (P10Y) [inail-guide, p. 23]
[29] dichiarazione di conformità — hasDeclaration — decreto ministeriale 22 gennaio 2008, n. 37 (decreto ministeriale 22 gennaio 2008, n. 37) [inail-guide, p. 16]
[30] CE marking — definedAs — a marking by which the manufacturer indicates (a marking by which the manufacturer indicates) [REG, Art. 3(25)]
[31] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall apply the following principles, in the order given (shall apply the following principles, in the order given) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[32] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — must be those of the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union (must be those of the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[33] lifetime — definedAs — the period from the moment that machinery (the period from the moment that machinery) [REG, Art. 3(34)]
[34] decision to revoke delegation — appliesFrom — the day following the publication (the day following the publication) [condition: or at a later date specified therein] [REG, Art. 47(3)]
[35] essential health and safety requirements — definedAs — the mandatory provisions, set out in Annex III (the mandatory provisions, set out in annex iii) [REG, Art. 3(14)]
[36] manufacturer — hasObligation — the EU declaration of conformity (the EU declaration of conformity) [condition: or the internet address or machine readable code, where the EU declaration of conformity can be accessed, in accordance with Article 10(8)] [REG, Annex III, 1.7.4.2]
[37] manufacturers — hasObligation — draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 (draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[38] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22 (shall draw up the eu declaration of incorporation in accordance with article 22) [condition: Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[39] products within the scope of this Regulation — definedAs — machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph (machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph) [REG, Art. 2(1)]
[40] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — EU declaration of incorporation (EU declaration of incorporation) [REG, Art. 16(2)]
[41] accreditation — definedAs — Article 2, point (10), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 (article 2, point (10), of regulation (ec) no 765/2008) [REG, Art. 3(26)]
[42] risultati dei controlli di cui al comma 8 — retentionPeriod — ultimi tre anni (P3Y) [condition: almeno quelli relativi agli ultimi tre anni] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 9]
[43] modalità di effettuazione delle verifiche periodiche — hasTimeLimit — entro dodici mesi (P12M) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13]
[44] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall assume responsibility for the compliance (shall assume responsibility for the compliance) [condition: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity] [REG, Art. 21(4)]
[45] essential requirement 1.3.3 — requiresMeasure — Precautions (precautions) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.3]
[46] essential requirement 1.1.3 materials and products — addressesRisk — endanger the health and safety of persons (endanger the health and safety of persons) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.3]
[47] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall assume responsibility for the compliance (shall assume responsibility for the compliance) [condition: By drawing up the EU declaration of incorporation] [REG, Art. 22(4)]
[48] original declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[49] CE marking — hasObligation — must be followed by the identification number of the notified body (must be followed by the identification number of the notified body) [condition: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied] [DIR, Annex III]
